headline: Profesor Hirafales Responde a la ‘Chilindrina’ por Pleito del Pasado
content: Me guarda mucho rencor The actor mexicano Rubén Aguirre, who interpreted Sor Jí­rafales en la serie El Chavo del Ocho, responded to María Antonietta de las Nieves la Chilindrina for questioning whether he now needs money to afford surgery.  When I worked, I made the program and my tours. Yes, indeed, I had quite some money, said Aguirre, noting everything changed after his wife suffered an accident in 2007.  My wife lost her leg, I sustained five fractures in one leg and in the pelvic area, along with severe damage to my spinal column which has prevented me from walking since then. With just the accident alone, millions went down the drain, revealed the Mexican star during a broadcast interview.  Still today (Maria Antonietta) holds onto resentment against me—Ive asked forgiveness countless times—but shes rather stubborn. She remains hurt over something I once mentioned about criticizing her show. We havent spoken, and it saddens me greatly because I hold great affection towards her. He concluded lamenting their ongoing disputes.

headline: Paulina Gana en México
content: The documentary film Paulina, directed by filmmaker Ricardo León, was awarded Best International Documentary Feature Film at the Guanajuato International Film Festival held in Mexico.  On its official Facebook event page, details were shared highlighting how director Paulina delivers immediate insight into desperate situations within communities rarely explored before. This narrative approach resonates deeply among audiences worldwide.  Additionally, the Peruvian documentary premiered weeks prior at other international festivals such as Vision du Réel Switzerland and EDOC in Ecuador, further establishing its global acclaim.

headline: Deportes
content: **Apertura:** After achieving five consecutive victories, Alianza Lima faced defeat away at Ayacucho FC losing 2–1. Despite being outplayed due to unfamiliar conditions like altitude and heat, key players struggled including Mimbela whose performance lagged significantly throughout the match.  In contrast, **Universidad Católica** showcased dominance over Universidad de San Marcos scoring four goals compared to one conceded. Young striker Takeuchi emerged prominently contributing twice amidst tactical brilliance displayed by forwards Manco-Sotil-Takeuchi dismantling opposing defenses effectively.  Meanwhile, Melgar secured victory over Cienciano thanks largely to veteran forward Israel Zelaya netting crucial late goal ensuring triumph in what many refer to as the southern classic clash between these teams.

headline: CRECE USO DE DROGA POR ’CYBERBULLYING
content: Se incrementa el uso de sustancias psicotrópicas debido al bullying virtual. Tres de cada diez colegiales con acceso a internet sufren acoso online según estudios. Este fenómeno contribuye al aumento del consumo de bebidas alcohólicas y cigarrillos, además de drogas más potentes como la marihuana, éxtasis y cocaína entre quienes enfrentan cyberbulling.
